title: Gov’t budget deficit nearly unchanged in September

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national government’s budget deficit held nearly steady at P248.9 billion in September as stronger revenues offset higher spending, but the nine-month gap remained above target. The Bureau of the Treasury said the fiscal gap rose by just 0.33 percent to P248.1 billion in the same month last year. READ: Spending ramp-up swells Aug budget deficit to P161.3B Still, the nine-month deficit widened to P1.30 trillion, up 16.64 percent from P1.12 trillion a year earlier and 8.08 percent above the P1.21-trillion January-to-September program.
